title: What Input Resolution Is Required for Bird Species Identification, and What Is Its Latency Cost on an Edge Device? A Study of 14 Input Resolutions and Six Architectures with On-Device Measurements
abstract: arXiv:2609.14247v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Bird-strike mitigation at wind farms requires identifying distant birds that span only tens of pixels, so the classifier's input resolution N is a design variable, not a fixed specification. We study it with a factorial design over 14 side lengths N (16 to 224), six architectures, two training and evaluation regimes and 30 random seeds -- 2,520 checkpoints and 5,040 evaluations -- plus latency measured on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano. Four results. (1) The selected N depends on the target: 0.90 is met on validation by ResNet50 at N=112 in an estimated 1.85 ms (0.8980 on test) and 0.95 by DINOv2-L at N=144 in 12.70 ms; changing the model buys more accuracy than raising N (+5.93 versus +2.33 points at N=112). translated_title: 鸟类物种识别需要多大的输入分辨率？其在边缘设备上的延迟成本是多少？——基于14种输入分辨率与六种架构的设备端实测研究
translated_abstract: 风电场的鸟击缓解措施需要识别仅占数十像素的远处鸟类，因此分类器的输入分辨率N是一个设计变量，而非固定规格。我们通过因子设计对其展开研究：涵盖14种边长N（16至224）、六种架构、两种训练与评估方案以及30个随机种子——共计2,520个检查点和5,040次评估——并在NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano上实测延迟。得到四个结果：(1) 所选N取决于目标精度：在验证集上，ResNet50在N=112时以估计1.85毫秒达到0.90（测试集为0.8980），DINOv2-L在N=144时以12.70毫秒达到0.95；更换模型比提高N能带来更高的精度收益（在N=112时分别为+5.93与+2.33个百分点）。(2) 降低N的收益取决于所采用的预处理路径：当每个个体从各自的文件中解码时，N从224降至80可节省13.5%的时间；但当检测器一次性解码整幅4K帧时，可节省46.2%；帕累托前沿集合从20个增长至……
tldr: 该论文通过包含2,520个检查点和设备端延迟实测的大规模因子实验，首次系统量化了鸟类识别任务中输入分辨率与模型架构的权衡关系，发现更换模型比提高分辨率更有效，且降低分辨率带来的延迟收益高度依赖于预处理路径的设计。
en_tdlr: Through a large-scale factorial study with 2,520 checkpoints and on-device latency measurements, this paper systematically quantifies the trade-off between input resolution and model architecture for bird species identification, showing that switching models is more effective than raising resolution, and that the latency benefit of lowering resolution depends heavily on the preprocessing pipeline design.
